blocks: Single record 0x09. Field order and widths, verbatim from the committed vendor table: device state 8 bits (NA 0xFF, VE_REG_DEVICE_STATE) · output state 8 bits (NA 0xFF, VE_REG_DC_OUTPUT_STATUS) · error code 8 bits (NA 0xFF, VE_REG_CHR_ERROR_CODE) · alarm reason 16 bits, no NA (VE_REG_ALARM_REASON) · warning reason 16 bits, no NA (VE_REG_ALARM_REASON) · input voltage 16 bits, 0.01 V, signed, range -327.68..327.66 V, NA 0x7FFF (VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL1_VOLTAGE) · output voltage 16 bits, 0.01 V, unsigned, range 0..655.34 V, NA 0xFFFF (VE_REG_DC_OUTPUT_VOLTAGE) · off reason 32 bits, no NA (VE_REG_DEVICE_OFF_REASON_2) · 32 bits unused.

**Device state is also a borrowed enum.** keshavdv decodes it with the MPPT `OperationMode` table (BULK, ABSORPTION, FLOAT, EQUALIZE_MANUAL…). Those states do not exist on a load disconnector. No source states what a Smart BatteryProtect puts in VE_REG_DEVICE_STATE.

unmappedReports: VE_REG_DEVICE_STATE (8-bit device state) — no MetricKind. ChargeStage is the only enum-shaped metric and a switch does not charge., VE_REG_CHR_ERROR_CODE — the SBP's own error set is E0 calibration failure, E1 short circuit, E2 over temperature, E3 under voltage, E4 over voltage, E5 configuration failure, E6 reference voltage failure, E7 BMS lockout, E8 reverse current. There is no fault MetricKind for a `switch` at all; ChargeStage::Fault is not reachable from a switch device., VE_REG_ALARM_REASON (16-bit alarm bitfield) — no metric for why a device alarmed., Warning reason (16-bit, same register type) — the vendor manual documents P2 over-temperature warning and P3 under-voltage warning as distinct from alarms: a warning is the current state, an alarm is latched until re-engagement. Nothing in the contract expresses "about to disconnect"., VE_REG_DEVICE_OFF_REASON_2 (32-bit off reason) — no metric for why a device is off. This is the third Victron dialect to carry an off-reason field; docs/catalog/ve-direct.md already flags it as contract finding #1., Internal temperature — the device has over-temperature protection (E2/P2) but publishes no temperature value in this record. `temperature` cannot be filled.
